description: The lane Soulforge-Tongs-Loopback-v1 will execute: the personal ERP MCP (server.mjs, default 127.0.0.1:4311) and, only when configured, the feature-gated HPP evidence ingress MCP (ingress_server.mjs). tracked_paths and carried_forward_prefixes were derived by tracing every import server.mjs and ingress_server.mjs actually reach (relative imports followed to their local files, bare specifiers collected as the third-party closure), not guessed — see docs/TONGS_LANE_RUNBOOK_V0.md §4 for the 2026-09-06 review finding (M6) that made this tracing necessary: no existing install/source-lanes/* lane's manifest carries @modelcontextprotocol/sdk or zod, so --previous-lane cannot be an as-is existing lane.

carried_forward_rationale.ui-workspace/node_modules/: Runtime closure only (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, zod — the exact and only two bare specifiers server.mjs/ingress_server.mjs transitively import; traced, not assumed). No install/source-lanes/* lane's own LANE_MANIFEST.sha256 carries these two packages as of 2026-09-06 (operations-lane-v2's ui-workspace/node_modules is the vite/babel/rollup toolchain closure only; linear-collect-v1 and buzz-collect-v1 carry no node_modules at all). --previous-lane must therefore be a staged directory whose ui-workspace/node_modules genuinely has both packages installed (copied from a checkout that already has them, with a freshly computed LANE_MANIFEST.sha256 for that staging directory), not any lane currently on disk. Root node_modules/ is deliberately not carried: the traced closure needs nothing from it (the repository root's only entry there, yaml, is not imported by this lane's two entry points).
